title: Limit F-invariants of the simple singularities and the Fermat hypersurfaces
summary: In this article, we compute the limit Hilbert--Kunz multiplicities and limit F-signatures of all the simple singularities and the Hilbert--Kunz multiplicities of the Fermat hypersurfaces, generalizing the well-known sec z + tan z formula by Gessel and Monsky for the A1 singularities, using the theory of h-functions. We also obtain a functional equation relating the phi-function of a hypersurface to its reflection.
